notes.title: Patch Version 1.05
notes.notes:
Hello Beasts!

 We have just release a new patch, and it's a game-saver for players on Intel processors! The update focuses on eradicating a persistent bug that has been causing game crashes, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience.
 The Beast Inside has just become a whole lot smoother and more beastly than ever before!

 You can always rollback to previous version of the game simply by clicking right mouse button on the game's title, select "Properties", then select "Betas" and from  the "Beta Participation" select version 1.03

notes.title: PC crash bugfix!
notes.notes:
Hello Beasts!
We started to work on a long awaited fix for the game crashing on start, but to do this, we need to gather  as much data as possible to be able to replicate the issue. People who encountered that bug, please sent us your PC specs here in the discussion, or at support@illusionray.com.

notes.title: The Dark Places Bundle is Available!
notes.notes:
Do you enjoy exploring the creepy places of this world, imagining there are monsters, demons and ghosts lurking in every dark corner around you? 1C Entertainment and Movie Games joined forces to bring you some of the most atmospheric indie horror games in one package. Now you save 71% on the whole bundle!

Get it [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23253/Dark_Places/]HERE[/url][/b]

The bundle includes: 
[list]
[*] Horror Story: Hallowseed
[*] The Beast Inside
[*] Through the Woods
[/list]

[b]Horror Story: Hallowseed[/b] is a story-driven psychological horror game. An obscure event causes two of your friends to disappear while camping in the woods. Left alone and stranded in an unknown place, you need to seek the answers about what happened, face the horrors around you and find your friends!

[b]The Beast Inside[/b] is a unique, gripping twist on thriller and survival horror. Immerse yourself in the story of long-buried secrets, personal tragedies, and madness. Play as two protagonists bound by a dark heritage. Combat the enemies, solve riddles and experience real terror in the 3D-scanned environment.

[b]Through the Woods[/b] is a third-person Norse horror adventure, set in a forest on the western shores of Norway, which tells the story of a mother and her missing son. Follow the path of a terrified woman who has forced herself to enter this terrible place for the sole purpose of finding her son, in a setting heavily influenced by Norse mythology and Norwegian folk tales.

For all of you who couldn’t put your hands on Lust from Beyond. 
For those who never heard about the dark, mysterious world of Lusst’ghaa.

[previewyoutube=WCmgncH28yY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]M Edition[/b] is a new version of Lust from Beyond, our esoteric survival horror. It’s tailored for those who love Lovecraftian stories for their atmosphere and lore rather than explicit content. 

If something stopped you from enjoying the base game, soon you’ll be able to immerse yourself into the world inspired by Lovecraft, Giger and Beksinski.

notes.title: WW1 strategy & firefighting tactics incoming!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to share 2 hot games just announced by our publisher Movie Games at Future Games Show! If you like any of them, follow them on Steam, add to your wishlist, and tell your friends about them.

[b]War Hospital[/b] is a unique society survival game about saving lives during World War 1 instead of taking them. As the commander of a field hospital, you will build a facility to heal combat injuries while the artillery shells explode ear-splittingly close.

[previewyoutube=Rg3G_NoG-ow;full][trailer][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1553000/War_Hospital/

[b]Fire Commander[/b] is a real-time tactical game about leading the most daring firefighting and rescue operations. Here, we’ll face a variety of situations that firefighters have to overcome in real life, including toxic spills, plane crashes, wildfires and more. 

[previewyoutube=6RBBqRE0r3E;full][trailer][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1362560/Fire_Commander/

We’re super excited! Both games look unique, and we can’t wait to play them. Remember to give them a follow if you want to support the creators!

notes.title: The best horror games to put the spooks up you this Halloween
notes.notes:
It’s Halloween! We’ve put the Hivemind Of Horror into a spooky jar of bubbling green liquid, and it’ll be pumping horror-themed articles onto the site today.

Halloween didn t really used to be that big of a deal in the UK, back when I were a kid. But now it is, so most people go to Halloween parties, or spooky club nights, or some other similar kind of terrifying celebration. I like to keep things traditional though, which means staying in on October 31st and kicking back with some Video Game Entertainment. Also I m COO of The NoSleep Podcast, and since we ve been working on Halloween content since around July, I think I deserve a break by the time it hits October s end.

So if, like me, you re after some video game recommendations in order to spend Halloween night alone, or even something to play after the festivities, then look no further. I ve compiled a list of thirteen (ooh) of the best horror games to be had this year.

notes.title: Face The Beast!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi Beasts![/h1]

We were calm here for a while, but now we are back with some new materials for you! 

First of all, our Beast have a new face - the new main graphic which, in our opinion, more precisely depicts the conflict between Nicolas and Adam ;)

[b]What do you think about it?[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32136890/a612fe6f99f7b01e9a7bed9cc2975db957f369f4.jpg[/img] 

Also, havew a look at our Steam gallery, we revealed [b]15 new screens[/b] from the game! 

We noticed increased interest in Beta, more info about it will be shared soon, because the size of the game has expanded since its first iteration, what required an additional focus on the development process. We just wanted to again express our gratitude for your patience and understanding! 


All The Be(a)st,

Illusion Ray Studio

notes.title: The Beast Inside speaks out!
notes.notes:
Dear Beasts,

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32136890/876c2a5082ab2f37be05465a55e99928f210bf4b.png[/img]

We are aware that many of you would be happy to see more regular updates here.

By now, we have been publishing them solely on the Kickstarter, but considering the growing community here, on Steam, and your constant support , we have decided to start to share them as well on Steam Community Hub.

For those of you who follow us on Kickstarter too this will be just a simple heads up that the next update is live so you definitely won't miss any of them.
While we hope that for all of you who have joined us via different sources, this will be a useful source of information regarding the progress of The Beast Inside.

Hence, here is a link to the[b] December Update[/b] with the sum up of 2018 :

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/the-beast-inside/posts/2376533

Have a look and let us know in the comments here what would you like to read more about!

And yes, The Beast Inside will be released in 2019. This is going to be our year.

All The Be(a)st,
Illusion Ray Studio
